claims.assertion: Yazhi says Earth’s human civilization is intentionally contained in 3D; awakening could trigger a reset, and advanced medical technology is withheld because it would disrupt that scenario.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: Her account of the human scenario.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says humans live about one-tenth as long as other Lyrian races.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: From a higher-dimensional perspective, she frames interstellar travel as changing frequency rather than crossing distance; planets are separate worlds only from lower-density perspectives.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says the description depends on perspective.
